implementation_notes: AI戦略2022 is a non-binding national strategy document building on AI Strategy 2019 and 2021. It sets strategic goals (目標0–4) covering crisis resilience (AI for National Resilience, Planetary Resilience), social implementation of AI, and responsible/trustworthy AI. No specific compliance deadlines, penalties, or enforcement mechanisms are defined. The document references the 'Human-Centered AI Social Principles' (2019) as the foundational ethical framework.
